## About the founder

Aashish Kushwah is a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at JIT, with interests and project work in software development, backend development, AI automation, AI agents, and API integrations. The About page is the primary first-party source for the founder's profile.

## Zenext.ai

Zenext.ai builds digital and software solutions, including AI automation, WhatsApp workflows, chatbots, websites, and related digital systems. See the official services page for current service descriptions.
